integrity: The publisher-indexed full text was inspected at the NOT-Exp CDF, PDF, reliability and hazard formulas, Figure 1 parameter descriptions, publication date, and MSC metadata. The endpoint asymptotics were independently derived from those formulas and replayed with a standalone checker from the packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The finding gives endpoint constraints rather than a complete global phase diagram of all interior hazard turning points.
The original plotting code is not reconstructed because the contradiction follows from exact endpoint formulas.
A very recent unindexed correction may exist outside the records examined.
title: NOT-Exp endpoint limits invalidate all four displayed hazard-shape examples
